blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Nighttime images are inherently susceptible to complex, compound degradations, making accurate quality assessment exceptionally challenging. Score-based IQA methods condense quality into a single number, lacking the multi-dimensional, language-grounded reasoning required for nighttime evaluation. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a more comprehensive alternative, yet remain constrained by a critical data gap: existing real-world IQA datasets are overwhelmingly daytime-centric and often built from outdated captures, while synthetic alternatives lack nighttime-specific degradation modeling, yielding artifacts far removed from authentic nighttime conditions. To bridge this gap, we present NightIQA, a dataset and benchmark suite purpose-built for MLLM-based nighttime IQA. It comprises three core components: NightIQA-Real, a real-world dataset of 1,769 high-resolution images that we captured ourselves with modern equipment, encompassing six canonical distortion types and structured multi-dimensional annotations; NightIQA-Bench, a benchmark of 1,078 visually grounded multiple-choice questions tailored to MLLM-based nighttime IQA, organized around a four-level evaluation hierarchy spanning Perception, Technical Assessment, Localization, and Reasoning; and NightIQA-Syn, an inherently scalable, scene-aware synthesis pipeline that jointly models global-level and instance-level degradations, with an initial release of 80k high-fidelity images alongside the full generation code. Fine-tuned on NightIQA with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), Qwen3-VL-8B outperforms open-source IQA methods and achieves higher overall accuracy than leading closed-source models, highlighting the value of domain-specific data and structured supervision.
blocks.zh: 夜间图像在本质上容易发生复杂的复合退化,因此准确的质量评估极具挑战性。 基于分数的IQA方法将质量压缩成一个单数,缺乏夜间评价所需的多维,基于语言的推理. 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)提供了一个更为全面的替代方案,但依然受到关键数据差距的制约:现有的现实世界的IQA数据集绝大多数以白天为中心,而且往往从过时的捕获中构建出来,而合成替代品缺乏针对夜间的降解模型,生成的文物远离真实的夜间条件. 为了弥合这一差距,我们提出了NightIQA,一个数据集和为基于MLLM的夜间IQA设计的基准套件。 它由三个核心部分组成:NightIQA-Real,一个由1,769幅高分辨率图像组成的现实世界数据集,我们用现代设备捕捉到我们自己,包括6种犬科扭曲类型和结构化多维说明;NightIQA-Bench,一个适合基于MLLM的夜间IQA的1,078个视距多选择问题的基准,它围绕一个四级评价等级组织,跨越感知、技术评估、局部化和理性;和NightIQA-Syn,一个内在可伸缩的、场景感知的合成管道,它联合模拟全球层面和实例层面的退化,与全代码一起初步发布80k高真度图像。 在"NightIQA"上进行精细调整,并配有"监督精选(SFT)"和"集团相对政策优化(GRPO)",Qun3-VL-8B超越了开源IQA方法,实现了高于领先的闭源模型的整体精度,凸显了域特有数据和结构化监督的价值.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Nighttime images are prone to complex, compound degradations that pose unique challenges for Image Quality Assessment (IQA) [ 43 , 50 ] . In such conditions, multiple artifacts—from sensor noise and exposure failures to various forms of motion and optical blur—tend to co-occur and interact within a single capture, producing degradation patterns far more intricate than those typical of daytime photography. The compound nature of these distortions renders existing IQA paradigms particularly inadequate.
blocks.zh: 夜间图像容易发生复杂而复杂的退化,对图像质量评估(IQA)[43,50]构成独特的挑战. 在这种情况下,多种文物——从传感器噪声和接触失败到各种形式的运动和光学模糊——最终在一次捕捉中共同渗透和相互作用,产生的退化模式远比白天摄影的典型模式复杂。 这些扭曲的复合性质使现有的《国际质量协定》模式特别不足。

blocks.en: Score-based IQA methods—from classical metrics like SSIM [ 37 ] and BRISQUE [ 23 ] to recent deep no-reference models [ 4 , 32 , 18 , 34 , 52 ] —condense quality into a single number, which alone cannot distinguish co-occurring distortion types, pinpoint where degradations occur, or explain their physical causes. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) [ 22 , 35 , 11 , 25 ] offer a more comprehensive alternative through language-grounded reasoning, and recent works [ 39 , 38 , 40 , 48 , 47 ] have confirmed their promise for general-purpose quality understanding. However, their effectiveness hinges on domain-specific data—a resource that remains critically absent for nighttime imagery. Mainstream IQA datasets [ 16 , 13 , 21 ] are overwhelmingly daytime-centric; the few nighttime-oriented resources [ 43 ] provide only coarse Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) without structured annotations; existing language-annotated datasets [ 39 , 41 ] do not systematically cover nighttime distortions; and current synthetic pipelines apply degradations as uniform post-processing without regard to scene content. We term this joint absence of structured real-world annotations, dedicated evaluation protocols, and scene-aware synthesis for nighttime imagery the Nighttime Distortion Gap .
blocks.zh: 基于分数的IQA方法——从SSIM[37]和BRISQUE[23]等古典度量衡到最近的深度无参考模型[4,32,18,34,52]——提高质量变为单一数字,单是数字无法区分共同发生的扭曲类型,确定降解发生地,或解释其物理原因. 多式联运大语言模型[22、35、11、25]通过基于语言的推理提供了更全面的备选方法,而最近的著作[39、38、40、48、47]确认了其对通用质量理解的承诺。 然而,其有效性取决于特定领域的数据,而这种资源对于夜间图像来说仍然极为缺乏。 主流IQA数据集[16,13,21]绝大多数以白天为中心;少数以夜间为导向的资源[43]只提供粗糙的平均值分数(MOS)而无结构化说明;现有语言附加说明的数据集[39,41]并没有系统地涵盖夜间扭曲;而目前的合成管在不考虑场景内容的情况下将降解作为统一的后处理. 我们把这种共同的缺乏结构化的现实世界说明、专用评价协议、以及夜间图像的场景感知合成称为"夜间扭曲差距"。

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce NightIQA, a comprehensive dataset and benchmark suite purpose-built for MLLM-based nighttime IQA. Our contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了NightIQA,一个为基于MLLM的夜间IQA设计的综合数据集和基准套件. 我们的贡献有三个方面:

blocks.en: • NightIQA-Real. A real-world nighttime dataset of 1,769 high-resolution images that we captured ourselves with modern photographic equipment, spanning three scene categories ( Nature , Indoor , and Urban ). Six representative distortion types are deliberately induced at three severity levels during shooting, and each image carries structured, multi-dimensional annotations covering distortion type, severity, spatial scope, affected region, and perceptual impact—going well beyond single-score labeling. • NightIQA-Bench. A dedicated evaluation benchmark tailored to MLLM-based nighttime IQA, built around a four-level evaluation hierarchy: (1) Perception —scene parsing at night; (2) Technical Assessment —distortion classification and severity grading; (3) Localization —spatial reasoning about degraded regions; and (4) Reasoning —causal analysis of degradation mechanisms. These four levels probe complementary cognitive dimensions, from scene recognition to causal quality understanding. • NightIQA-Syn. A scene-aware synthesis pipeline that takes high-quality, distortion-free images sourced from Unsplash [ 33 ] and applies controlled degradations at both global (e.g., sensor noise, underexposure) and instance (e.g., localized motion blur, focus blur) levels, producing spatially coherent artifacts consistent with scene geometry. The pipeline is inherently scalable; we release an initial corpus of 80k high-fidelity images with automatically derived structured annotations alongside the full generation code.
blocks.zh: • NightIQA-Real。 一个由1,769个高分辨率图像组成的真实世界夜间数据集,我们用现代摄影设备捕捉到我们自己,它跨越了三种场景类别(自然、室内和城市)。 6种有代表性的扭曲类型在射击期间被故意从3个严重级别诱发,每个图像都带有结构分明的多维说明,涵盖扭曲类型、严重性、空间范围、受影响区域和概念影响——远远超出了单分标签的范围。 • NightIQA-Bench。 围绕四级评价等级,根据基于最低劳动报酬的夜间评估制定专门的评价基准: (1)感觉-夜间剖析;(2)技术评估-扭曲分类和严重程度分级;(3)局部化-退化区域空间推理;和(4)理性-退化机制的因果关系分析. 这四个层次探索了互补认知维度,从场景识别到因果质量理解. • NightIQA-Syn。 一个场景感知合成管道取自Unsplash[33]的高质量,无扭曲的图像,并在全球(如感知噪声,曝光不足等)和实例(如局部运动模糊,焦点模糊等)两个级别上应用可控降解,生成与场景几何相符合的空间相通的文物. 管道具有内在的可伸缩性;我们释放出由80k高纯度图像构成的初始体,在全生成码的同时,自动得到结构化的说明.

blocks.en: 2.1 Image Quality Assessment
blocks.zh: 2.1 图像质量评估

blocks.en: IQA methods have evolved along two successive lines.
blocks.zh: IQA方法沿两条相接而来.

blocks.en: Score-based approaches range from full-reference metrics such as SSIM [ 37 ] and LPIPS [ 51 ] to no-reference estimators like BRISQUE [ 23 ] and NIQE [ 24 ] . Deep learning further advanced this line through CNN-based score regression [ 4 , 32 ] , multi-scale Transformer architectures [ 18 , 9 ] , and vision-language cross-modal scoring [ 34 , 52 ] . While progressively more accurate, all score-based methods inherently condense quality into a single scalar, precluding structured quality understanding.
blocks.zh: 计分方法包括全面参考指标,如SSIM[37]和LPIPS[51],以及BRISQUE[23]和NIQE[24]等无参考估计。 深度学习通过基于CNN的分数回归[4,32],多尺度变形器架构[18,9],以及视觉语言跨模式评分[34,52],进一步推进了这条线. 所有以分数为基础的方法虽然都逐渐更加准确,但本质上将质量收缩为单一的分数,排除了结构化的质量理解.

blocks.en: MLLM-based approaches reframe IQA as a language generation task, enabling richer output beyond numerical scores. Q-Align [ 40 ] maps images to text-defined quality levels via discrete rating anchors. DeQA-Score [ 46 ] models score distributions to capture rating uncertainty. DepictQA [ 48 , 47 ] produces hierarchical descriptions covering severity, causation, and spatial extent. Most recently, Q-Insight [ 19 ] and VisualQuality-R1 [ 42 ] apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [ 30 ] to move beyond the imitation ceiling of supervised fine-tuning, yielding improved reasoning fidelity for quality scoring and distortion perception. Despite this progress, existing MLLM-based IQA methods are developed and evaluated almost exclusively on daytime-centric data; their behavior under compound nighttime degradations remains largely unexamined.
blocks.zh: 基于 MLLM 的方法将 IQA 重新设定为语言生成任务,使得输出比数值分数更丰富. Q-对齐 [40] 通过离散的评级锚点将图像映射到文本定义的质量级别. DeQA-Score [46] 模型得分分布以获取评级不确定性. DepictQA [48,47] 提出了涵盖严重程度、因果关系和空间范围的分级描述。 最近,Q-Insight[19]和VisualQuality-R1[42]应用了GROPO相对政策优化(GRPO)[30],以超越被监督的微调的仿制上限,使质量评分和扭曲感的推理更加忠实. 尽管取得了这一进展,但几乎完全根据以日为中心的数据,开发和评价现有的基于MLLM的IQA方法;它们在复合夜间退化下的行为基本上仍未受到审查。

blocks.en: 2.2 IQA Datasets and Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 IQA 数据集和基准

blocks.en: Real-world datasets. In-the-wild datasets such as KonIQ-10k [ 16 ] and SPAQ [ 13 ] collect authentically degraded images from consumer devices and annotate them with scalar MOS labels, offering high ecological validity but limited annotation expressiveness. Language-annotated resources have progressively enriched annotation granularity: Q-Instruct [ 39 ] provides 200K instruction-response pairs for quality-aware tuning; Q-Bench [ 38 ] and Q-Bench+ [ 53 ] establish multi-dimensional evaluation covering single-image and paired-comparison settings; Co-Instruct [ 41 ] adds comparative quality descriptions; and Q-Ground [ 10 ] integrates spatial grounding via distortion segmentation. However, these datasets are predominantly collected from daytime scenes, and neither their acquisition strategies nor their annotation schemes target the distortions characteristic of nighttime photography. Even nighttime-specific datasets such as NNID [ 43 ] provide only scalar MOS labels collected with outdated devices, lacking both structured language annotations and modern image fidelity. No existing benchmark systematically evaluates MLLM-based quality understanding under nighttime conditions.
blocks.zh: 现实世界数据集. KONIQ-10k [16]和SPAQ [13]等零散数据集从消费设备中收集被真实降解的图像,并用斯卡勒MOS标签进行注释,提供了较高的生态有效性但有限的注释表达. 语言说明资源已逐渐丰富了注释颗粒性:Q-指示[39]提供200K指令-应答对来进行质感调和;Q-Bench [38]和Q-Bench+ [53]建立多维评价,涵盖单相和对相比较的设置;共同指示[41]增加了比较质量描述;和Q-Ground [10]通过扭曲分化来整合空间地平. 然而,这些数据集主要是从白天场景中收集的,其获取策略和注释方案都没有针对夜间摄影的扭曲特征. 即使是NNID等夜间特定数据集[43]也只提供用过时设备所收集的scalar MOS标签,缺乏结构化语言说明和现代图像忠实. 没有一项现有基准系统地评价夜间条件下基于最低劳动报酬的质量理解。

blocks.en: Synthetic datasets. Controlled-distortion datasets such as TID2013 [ 28 ] and KADID-10k [ 21 ] apply predetermined degradations to pristine images, enabling precise control over distortion type and severity. This paradigm has been widely adopted for scalable training data generation. However, existing synthetic pipelines apply degradations as uniform post-processing transforms that ignore scene content, producing artifacts that diverge substantially from real nighttime captures where degradations are shaped by sensor characteristics, scene geometry, and spatially varying illumination.
blocks.zh: 合成数据集. 受控-扭曲数据集如TID2013 [28]和KADID-10k [21]对原始图像应用了预定的降解,从而能够精确地控制扭曲类型和严重性. 这种范式被广泛用于可扩展的培训数据生成. 然而,现有的合成管将降解作为统一的后处理转变,忽略了场景内容,生成的文物与实时夜间捕获有很大不同,因为降解是由传感器特征、场景几何和空间相差悬殊的发光所形成的。

blocks.en: These observations point to a consistent gap: the community lacks dedicated nighttime data collection, structured annotations, and evaluation protocols on the real-data side, and scene-aware synthesis on the synthetic-data side—the very deficiencies that NightIQA is designed to address.
blocks.zh: 这些观察指出一个始终存在的差距:社区缺乏专门的夜间数据收集、结构化说明和实时数据方面的评价协议,以及合成数据方面的场景感知合成——即NightIQA所设计的缺陷。

blocks.en: 3 The NightIQA Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 NightIQA 数据集

blocks.en: NightIQA has three coupled components: NightIQA-Real, real nighttime images with multi-dimensional structured annotations; NightIQA-Bench, a benchmark organizing these annotations by cognitive complexity; and NightIQA-Syn, a scalable scene-aware synthetic corpus for training.
blocks.zh: NightIQA有三个相接组件: NightIQA-Real,具有多维结构化说明的实时夜间图像; NightIQA-Bench,一个根据认知复杂性组织这些说明的基准;和 NightIQA-Syn,一个可伸缩的场景感知合成器,用于训练.

blocks.en: 3.1 NightIQA-Real Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 NightIQA-真实数据集

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Data Collection.
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 数据收集。

blocks.en: Existing IQA datasets are not merely lacking in nighttime content—they also fail to provide controlled coverage of the distortion types that define nighttime photography. To address both deficiencies, we build NightIQA-Real through controlled real-world capture: 1,769 high-resolution nighttime images are shot on location using modern photographic equipment, spanning three scene categories: Nature , Indoor , and Urban . Crucially, rather than passively collecting images of varying quality, we deliberately induce six representative distortion types during capture— Noise , Underexposure , Overexposure , Motion Blur , Focus Blur , and Camera Shake —each at three severity levels ( Slight , Moderate , Severe ). This controlled acquisition strategy ensures systematic coverage of nighttime degradations while preserving the authenticity of real-world capture conditions. Because the scenes are shot on location, they also retain the complex illumination intrinsic to night photography—specular reflections, and mixed multi-source lighting (e.g., neon, sodium-vapor, and LED sources at differing color temperatures)—conditions that uniform synthetic post-processing cannot faithfully reproduce. To ensure privacy, all images were strictly screened to exclude clear faces and sensitive details (Supp. Sec. G).
blocks.zh: 现有的IQA数据集不仅缺乏夜间内容——它们也未能提供定义夜间摄影的扭曲类型的控制覆盖. 为了解决这两个缺陷,我们通过控制真实世界的捕捉来构建"夜之地"(NightIQA-Real):使用现代摄影设备拍摄了1,769个高分辨率的夜间影像,它们跨越了自然、室内和都市三个场景类别。 关键是,我们不是被动地收集质量不同的图像,而是在捕捉过程中故意诱导六种代表性的扭曲类型——噪音、暴露不足、过度暴露、动作模糊、焦点模糊和相机摇晃——在三个严重级别(轻度、中度和严重)进行。 这种有控制的获取策略确保系统地覆盖夜间退化,同时保持真实世界捕捉条件的真实性. 由于场景是在位置上拍摄的,它们还保留了夜相所固有的复杂照明——光谱反射,以及混合多源照明(如霓虹,钠-活化,和不同色温下LED源)——统一合成后处理不能忠实地复制的条件. 为确保隐私,对所有图像进行了严格筛选,以排除清晰的面相和敏感细节(Supp. Sec. G)。

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Annotation Pipeline.
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 注释管道。

blocks.en: We annotate in two phases. In Phase 1 (Multi-Model Ensemble Pre-Labeling), four frontier MLLMs from different providers (GPT-5 [ 31 ] , Gemini 2.5 Pro [ 12 ] , Doubao-Seed-1.6-Vision [ 7 ] , and GLM-4.5V [ 14 ] ) annotate each image independently; we keep a label only when at least three of them agree, which provides consistent initial labels for human review. In Phase 2 (Human Verification & Refinement), professional annotators review every image and correct misidentified distortions, severity ratings, and ungrounded descriptions. This keeps quality close to fully manual annotation at much lower cost; we detail the platform, workflow, and audit protocol in Supp. Sec. A.
blocks.zh: 我们分两个阶段进行注释。 在第一阶段(多模共聚预标)中,来自不同供应商的4个前沿MLLM(GPT-5 [31],双子座2.5 Pro [12],杜宝-种子-1.6-Vision [7],和GLM-4.5V [14])分别独立地对每个图像进行注释;我们只有在其中至少三个同意时才保留一个标签,这为人类审查提供了一致的初始标签. 在第二阶段(人类核查和完善),专业的注释者审查每个图像并纠正被误认的扭曲、严重程度评级和没有根据的描述。 这使得质量接近完全人工注释,成本要低得多;我们在Supp中详细说明平台、工作流程和审计协议。 A级

blocks.en: 3.2 NightIQA-Bench: Evaluation Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3.2 《夜间国际质量评估-奔驰:评价基准》

blocks.en: We turn NightIQA-Real’s structured, multi-dimensional annotations into targeted evaluation questions to build NightIQA-Bench, a visually grounded multiple-choice question-answering benchmark that tests MLLM capabilities through a four-level evaluation hierarchy (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们把NightIQA-Real的有条理的多维说明变成目标明确的评价问题来构建NightIQA-Bench,这是一个视觉上基于多选择的问答基准,通过四级评价等级来测试MLLM的能力(图2).

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Four-Level Evaluation Hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 四级评价等级。

blocks.en:
The four levels span complementary cognitive dimensions, mirroring how a human assessor inspects an image, and as Section 5.2 shows they are not equally difficult: Technical Assessment (L2) is empirically the hardest axis for nearly all models. Level 1 (Perception) recognizes the subject and scene content under nighttime conditions and complex artificial illumination. Level 2 (Technical Assessment) identifies the primary distortion and grades its severity. Level 3 (Localization) locates where a distortion is most evident and ties it to specific image regions. Level 4 (Reasoning) explains why details are degraded, attributing the primary and secondary factors and their interactions.
Representative examples across the four levels are shown in Figure 4 . All questions follow a standardized multiple-choice format and are accompanied by a visually grounded rationale derived from observable image evidence. The final validated benchmark comprises 1,078 questions, distributed across the four levels as Level 1: 99, Level 2: 344, Level 3: 344, and Level 4: 291. Extended per-level examples and the full filtering pipeline are provided in Supp. Sec. C.
blocks.zh:
这四个层面跨越互补的认知维度,反映了人类评估者如何检查一幅图像,正如第5.2节所显示的,它们并非同样困难:技术评估(L2)在经验上是几乎所有模型最难的轴心. 1级(Perception)在夜间条件和复杂的人工发光下,识别主体和场景内容. 第二级(技术评估)查明了主要扭曲情况及其严重程度。 第三级(本地化)定位最明显的失真之处,并将其与特定图像区域联系起来. 第4级(Reasoning)解释了细节为何退化,将主要和次要因素及其相互作用归为因素。

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Question Quality Control.
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 质检问题.

blocks.en: Benchmark reliability demands that every question is unambiguous, visually answerable, and discriminative. We enforce this through a two-stage filter: an MLLM-as-a-judge module first screens candidates for logical errors, weak distractors, and insufficient discriminability; domain experts then manually verify question clarity and visual grounding. Only questions passing both stages are retained.
blocks.zh: 基准的可靠性要求每个问题都明确、可视地回答并具有歧视性。 我们通过一个两阶段的过滤器来执行:一个MLLM-as-a-judge模块首先筛选候选人的逻辑错误,弱的分心器和不足的可歧视性;然后域专家手动验证问题清晰度和可视地平面. 只保留经过两个阶段的问题。

blocks.en: The training and evaluation splits share no identical or even visually similar scenes. We embed all 1,769 images with DINOv2 [ 26 ] and use feature similarity to assign near-duplicate scenes to the same side of the partition, followed by a manual review that removes any residual visual overlap. This yields a 953-image GRPO training corpus and an 816-image held-out evaluation set with no scene overlap, from which the 1,078 benchmark questions are drawn (details in Supp. Sec. B).
blocks.zh: 培训和评价的分拆没有相同或甚至视觉相似的场景。 我们将所有1,769个图像都嵌入了DINOv2 [26] ,并使用特征相似性,将相片近似重复的场景分配到分区的同一侧,然后进行人工审查去除任何剩余视觉重叠. 这产生了953-图像GRPO培训大纲和816-图像被搁置的评价,没有场景重叠,从中得出了1 078个基准问题(详见Supp. Sec. B)。

blocks.en: 3.3 NightIQA-Syn: Scene-Aware Synthetic Data
blocks.zh: 3.3 NightIQA-同步:场景-智能合成 数据

blocks.en: NightIQA-Real provides high-quality annotations but is limited in scale: real-world collection is costly, scene diversity is bounded, and certain distortion-severity combinations are hard to induce intentionally. NightIQA-Syn complements it with a scene-aware pipeline that generates degraded nighttime images with automatically derived structured labels for large-scale MLLM training. Starting from distortion-free Unsplash [ 33 ] sources (clean exposure, sharp focus, no visible artifacts), it applies degradations organized into two categories by their spatial extent. Global-level distortions come from sensor or camera behavior and affect the whole image uniformly, whereas instance-level distortions are tied to specific scene elements and follow scene geometry. Each distortion is produced by a dedicated operator (Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh: NightIQA-Real提供高质量的说明,但规模有限:现实世界的收集成本高昂,场景多样性被限制,某些扭曲-严重性组合很难被故意诱导. NightIQA-Syn用一个场景感知管来补充它,它生成退化的夜间图像,并自动得到结构化的标签来进行大规模MLLM训练. 从无扭曲的Unsplash[33]源(干净的暴露,尖锐的焦点,没有可见的文物)开始,它按其空间范围将降解分出两类. 全球层面的扭曲来自传感器或相机行为,并统一地影响整个图像,而实例层面的扭曲则与特定场景元素相接并跟随场景几何. 每个扭曲由一个专用操作员产生(图5.).

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Global-Level Degradation.
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 全球一级的退化。

blocks.en: We model four types, partly via Albumentations [ 5 ] (Figure 5 , left): Noise (chromatic and Gaussian sensor noise typical of nighttime capture); Underexposure (intensity attenuation with added noise); Global Overexposure (luminance boosting with highlight bloom); and Camera Shake (directional motion blur with randomized extent and orientation). Exact operators, sampling ranges, and per-severity parameters are detailed in Supp. Sec. D.1.
blocks.zh: 我们模拟四种类型,部分通过专辑[5](图5,左): 噪音(夜间捕捉典型的色相和高斯传感器噪声); 接触不足(加噪音的强度减弱); 全球过度接触(以亮度开花推动发光); 相机摇晃(以随机程度和取向模糊的方向运动)。 精确操作员、采样范围和恒定参数详见Supp. D.1节。

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Instance-Level Degradation.
blocks.zh: 3.3.2 实例级退化。

blocks.en: Some nighttime distortions are inherently localized: motion blur affects only moving objects, focus blur varies with depth, and overexposure blooms around point light sources. Applying them uniformly would misrepresent how they appear in real captures. Our instance-level pipeline (Figure 5 , right) proceeds in three stages. (1) Target identification : a vision-language model checks each image for elements suitable to a given distortion (e.g., movable objects for motion blur, likely-misfocused objects for focus blur, bright point sources for local overexposure) and names the candidate targets it finds; only images with valid targets enter the corresponding branch. (2) Spatial localization : Rex-Omni [ 17 ] grounds these candidate targets via open-vocabulary localization and SAM3 [ 8 ] extracts pixel-accurate masks, with ZoeDepth [ 3 ] supplying monocular depth for depth-dependent effects such as focus blur. (3) Spatially-coherent rendering : dedicated operators synthesize spatially varying degradations. Local Overexposure adds atmospheric bloom and glare halos around bright sources, Motion Blur accumulates warped samples along randomized trajectories in linear color space, and Focus Blur applies depth-aware, spatially varying blur radii for perceptually plausible bokeh. Full algorithms and parameter ranges are provided in Supp. Sec. D.2.
blocks.zh: 一些夜间扭曲是内在的局部化的:运动模糊只会影响移动的物体,焦点模糊随深度而变化,过度暴露会围绕点光源而开花. 统一应用它们会歪曲它们在真实捕捉中的表现。 我们的试管(图5,右)分三个阶段进行。 (1)目标识别 :一个视觉语言模型检查每个图像中适合给定扭曲的元素(例如,运动模糊的可移动对象,对焦模糊的可能的偏移对象,对局部过度暴露的亮点源)并命名其发现的候选目标;只有具有有效目标的图像才进入相应的分支. blocks.en: 3.3.3 SFT Data Construction.
blocks.zh: 3.3.3 资助恐怖主义 数据建设.

blocks.en: We release an initial 80,000-image corpus with full generation code. Each image carries automatically generated structured annotations in two formats: Basic QA , three single-turn pairs probing distortion type, severity, and spatial scope; and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) , a long-form reasoning sample that describes image content, identifies the distortion, and characterizes its spatial distribution. We sample 6,769 images for SFT, balancing distortion-type and severity coverage (Supp. Sec. D.3), stored as conversation-style records compatible with standard MLLM fine-tuning frameworks.
blocks.zh: 我们发布了一个初始的80,000-图像 与完整的代号。 每个图像都以两种格式自动生成结构化说明: Basic QA,由三对单回转对来检测扭曲类型,严重程度,和空间范围;和Cain-of-Thought (CoT),是描述图像内容,识别扭曲,并描述其空间分布的长式推理样本. 我们为SFT取样了6 769个图像,平衡了扭曲类型和严重性覆盖(Supp. Sec. D.3),作为与标准MLLM微调框架相兼容的谈话式记录被储存。

blocks.en: 4 Baseline Construction
blocks.zh: 4 基线建筑

blocks.en: We build a baseline on Qwen3-VL-8B [ 2 ] trained on NightIQA in two stages: SFT on the synthetic NightIQA-Syn data, followed by GRPO on the real NightIQA-Real annotations. We keep the backbone architecture unchanged and intend the pipeline as a reproducible reference rather than a new model.

blocks.en: 5.1 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价设置

blocks.en:
We benchmark 22 zero-shot baselines across three families: closed-source frontier models (GPT-4o [ 25 ] , GPT-5 Mini [ 31 ] , Gemini [ 12 , 15 ] , Doubao [ 6 ] , Claude [ 1 ] ), open-source VLMs (MiMo [ 44 , 45 ] , GLM-4.5V/4.6V [ 14 , 49 ] , Qwen3-VL [ 2 ] , Qwen3.5 [ 29 ] , InternVL3.5 [ 36 ] ), and domain-specific IQA models (DepictQA [ 48 ] , Q-Instruct [ 39 ] , VisualQuality-R1 [ 42 ] , Q-Insight [ 19 ] ); see Table 2 for exact variants.
We also report final SFT+GRPO in Table 2 and analyze GRPO-only in the ablation. We report MCQ accuracy on L1–L4 and overall accuracy over all 1,078 held-out questions from the 816-image scene-disjoint evaluation set.
blocks.zh:
我们以22个零射入基线为基准衡量三个家庭:闭源边疆模型(GPT-4o [25],GPT-5 Mini [31],双子座 [12,15],杜宝. [6],克洛德 [1]),开源VLMs (米莫 [44,45], GLM-4.5V/4.6V [14,49], Qun3-VL [2], Qun3.5 [29], InternVL3.5 [36]), 和特定域的IQA模型 (DeptQA [48], Q-Instruct [39],可视质量-R1 [42], Q-Insight [19]; 确切的变体参见表2.
我们还在表2中报告最终的SFT+GROPO,并在减缩中只分析GROPO. 我们报告关于L1-L4的MCQ准确性以及816-图像场景-失联评价集中所有1 078个搁置问题的总体准确性。

blocks.en: 5.2 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果和分析

blocks.en: Across all evaluated models, NightIQA-Bench surfaces four consistent patterns (Table 2 , Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 在所有评估的模型中,NightIQA-Bench呈现出四种一致的模式(表2,图1)。

blocks.en: Cognitive Stratification Validates Benchmark Design. Accuracy is far from uniform: most general VLMs peak on Perception (L1) and bottom out on Technical Assessment (L2). Even the top Perception scorer, Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite [ 15 ] , slides from 89.90% (L1) to 73.26% (L2). General VLMs parse nighttime scenes but lack the expertise to classify their distortions.
blocks.zh: 认知分层 验证基准设计。 准确性远非一成不变:大多数一般的VLM在Perception(L1)上最高峰,在技术评估(L2)上最下最高峰. 甚至顶级感知分数器双子座-3.1-Flash-Lite [15],从89.90%(L1)滑至73.26%(L2). 通用VLMs解析了夜间场景,但缺乏将其扭曲分类的专门知识.

blocks.en: Domain-Specific IQA Models Exhibit a Severe Gap. Dedicated IQA methods cluster at the bottom: DepictQA [ 48 ] (49.10%), Q-Instruct [ 39 ] (51.39%), Q-Insight [ 19 ] (59.70%), and VisualQuality-R1 [ 42 ] (61.30%) trail nearly all general VLMs and falter on quality-centric axes such as Technical Assessment (L2) and Localization (L3). Their daylight-centric training with generic synthetic degradations (e.g., Gaussian blur, JPEG) leaves them ill-equipped for nighttime artifacts such as color noise and uneven exposure.
blocks.zh: 域-特定IQA模型显示出一个严重的缺口。 专用IQA方法集群位于底部:DepctQA [48] (49.10%),Q- 指示 [39] (51.39%),Q- Insight [19] (59.70%),和VisualQuality-R1 [42] (61.30%) 跟踪几乎所有普通VLM,在技术评估(L2)和本地化(L3)等以质量为中心的轴上摇摇欲坠. 他们的以日光为中心的训练具有一般的合成降解性(如高斯模糊,JPEG),使得他们无法胜任夜间的文物,如颜色噪音和不均匀的暴露.

blocks.en: Scaling Alone Cannot Close the Nighttime Gap. Parameter scaling yields inconsistent, saturating returns: within Qwen3.5 accuracy is non-monotonic in size, and the largest Qwen3.5-397B [ 29 ] (80.24%) is still edged out by our domain-aligned 8B model, with its shortfall sharpest on L2 (74.42%). These results suggest that scaling alone is insufficient, and domain-specific degradation knowledge is a critical missing factor.
blocks.zh: 缩小无法关闭夜隙 。 参数缩放产量不一致,饱和回放:在Qwen3.5的精度内为非模态大小,最大的Qwen3.5-397B [29] (80.24%)仍然被我们域相通的8B模型所抵消出,其L2(74.42%)的缺口最尖锐. 这些结果表明,单靠规模是不够的,针对具体领域的退化知识是一个关键的缺失因素。

blocks.en: NightIQA Brings an 8B Model to Frontier-Level Accuracy. Our SFT+GRPO model attains the best overall average (80.71%), surpassing the ∼ 50 × {\sim}50\times larger Qwen3.5-397B (80.24%) and the strongest closed-source model, Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite (78.94%), with a clear lead on Technical Assessment (L2, 78.20%) where general VLMs drop sharply. Larger general VLMs keep narrow leads on single axes (Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite on L1, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on L3, Qwen3.5-397B on L4), but none matches our overall accuracy and L2 lead, supporting our data-centric motivation.
blocks.zh: NightIQA将一款8B模型带入了前沿级精确度. 我们的SFT+GRPO模式达到最佳总体平均水平(80.71%),超过了 Qwen3.5-397B(80.24%)和最强的闭源模型双子座3.1-Flash-Lite(78.94%),技术评估(L2,78.20%)明显领先,普通VLM急剧下降。 较大的通用VLM在单轴上保留了狭长的线索(Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite在L1上;Quen3.5-35B-A3B在L3上;Quen3.5-397B在L4上;但无一与我们的整体精确度和L2铅相匹配,支持了我们以数据为中心的动机.

blocks.zh: 5.3 读取研究

blocks.en: We ablate each training stage and data source from the same Qwen3-VL-8B base model (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们放弃了每个培训阶段和同一Qune3-VL-8B基准模型的数据来源(表3)。

blocks.en: Effect of GRPO (NightIQA-Real). GRPO alone adds 13.4 pp to the average (63.82% to 77.18%), with the largest gains on L2 (+15.7) and L3 (+14.8): NightIQA-Real’s reasoning trajectories are the dominant driver in our ablation, teaching distortion recognition and spatial reasoning at night.
blocks.zh: GRPO的效果(NightIQA-Real). 仅GRPO就平均增加了13.4页(63.82%至77.18%),其中L2(+15.7)和L3(+14.8)的收益最大: NightIQA-Real的推理轨迹是我们在晚间进行扭曲识别和空间推理的主要驱动力。

blocks.en: Effect of SFT (NightIQA-Syn). Prepending SFT lifts the average a further 3.5 pp (77.18% to 80.71%), concentrated on L4 (+5.2) and L1 (+5.1). These gains stack on top of GRPO’s: NightIQA-Syn’s large-scale distortion vocabulary adds supervision beyond NightIQA-Real’s reasoning traces.
blocks.zh: SFT的影响(NightIQA-Syn). Prevention SFT又提高了平均3.5页(77.18%至80.71%),主要集中在L4(+5.2%)和L1 (+5.1)。 这些收益堆积在GRPO之上: NightIQA-Syn的大规模扭曲词汇在NightIQA-Real的推理痕迹之外增加了监督.

blocks.en: Training dynamics across epochs. Both regimes generally improve before saturating or slightly regressing (Table 4 ). SFT+GRPO climbs from 78.57% (epoch 1) to a peak 80.71% at epoch 4, which is also its best L4 (80.07%), then dips to 80.43% at epoch 5; GRPO-only peaks later (77.18%, epoch 5). We therefore adopt SFT+GRPO at epoch 4 for its best average and best L4 (Reasoning), the highest-order and most challenging axis.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present NightIQA: 1,769 originally captured, multi-dimensionally annotated nighttime images; a four-level benchmark spanning perception to causal reasoning; and a scene-aware synthesis pipeline releasing 80k images with code. Across 22 zero-shot baselines, we expose a severe nighttime domain gap that scaling alone does not close. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B with SFT and GRPO yields a 17-point gain and the best overall accuracy of any evaluated system, including models ∼ 50 × {\sim}50\times larger, supporting the importance of domain-specific data and structured supervision. A natural next step is to grow NightIQA beyond the nighttime regime, extending the dataset to daytime and broader real-world scenarios and enriching it with additional scenes, distortion types, and annotation dimensions, so that it can serve as a foundation for general MLLM-based image quality assessment.
blocks.zh: 我们提出NightIQA:1,769个最初捕获的多维附加注释的夜间图像;一个跨越感知到因果推理的四级基准;以及一个场景感知合成管道,释放出80克有代码的图像. 在22个零射线基线中,我们暴露出一个严重的夜间域间隙,单靠缩放无法弥合. 用 SFT 和 GRPO 来微调 Qune3-VL-8B 得出了17分的得分和任何被评价系统的最佳整体准确性,包括型号为 ∼ 50 × sim}50\时间更大,支持了特定域数据和结构化监督的重要性. 一个自然的下一步是将NightIQA发展出超越了夜间系统,将数据集扩展至白天和更广泛的现实世界情景,并用额外的场景,扭曲类型和注释维度来丰富它,这样它就可以作为基于MLLM的一般图像质量评估的基础.

blocks.en: C.2 MCQ Structure and CoT Generation Protocol
blocks.zh: C.2 MCQ结构与COT生成议定书

blocks.en: To keep the benchmark consistent across images and graders, every question is generated against a fixed schema rather than free-form prompting. We detail the three components that govern this schema below.
blocks.zh: 为了在图像和分层器之间保持基准的一致性,每个问题都是根据固定的计数生成的,而不是任意形式的提示. 下面我们详述指导这一计划的三个组成部分。

blocks.en: All questions and rationales are restricted to the annotation vocabulary defined in Section 3.1 : the six canonical distortion types ( Noise , Underexposure , Overexposure , Motion Blur , Focus Blur , Camera Shake ), the severity levels, and the spatial-scope labels ( global / local ). Binding the wording to this taxonomy ensures that questions probe the same attributes that the annotations record, and that an answer can always be traced back to a grounded field.
blocks.zh: 所有问题和理由都限于第3.1节所定义的注解词汇:六种犬形扭曲类型(噪声、暴露不足、过度暴露、动作模糊、焦点模糊、相机摇晃等)、严重程度和空间范围标签(全球/局部)。 将措辞与这个分类法联系起来,可以确保问题探究说明所记录的相同属性,一个答案总是可以追溯到一个被禁域。

blocks.en: Each image yields questions across all four cognitive levels, with Level 2 contributing two complementary question types, so a single image produces both a distortion-identification item and a severity-grading item at that level. The levels follow the body’s definitions: L1 (Perception) recognizes the subject and scene content visible under nighttime conditions; L2 (Technical Assessment) identifies the primary distortion and grades its severity; L3 (Localization) probes spatial scope and the affected region; and L4 (Reasoning) probes causal and comparative judgments that require integrating multiple cues. Most questions are four-option single-answer items following a 1+2+1 design: one correct answer, two hard distractors drawn from attributes that are plausible for the same scene (e.g., a neighboring severity level, a co-occurring distortion type, or an alternative affected region), and one easy distractor that is clearly inconsistent with the image. The severity-grading items at Level 2 instead use the three fixed options Slight / Moderate / Severe , so that any severity level can be the correct answer. This composition keeps the task discriminative while avoiding trivially guessable items.
blocks.zh: 每个图像都产生贯穿所有四个认知层次的问题,第二级贡献了两种互补的问题类型,因此一个图像既产生扭曲识别项目,又产生该级别的重度分级项目. 这些级别遵循机构的定义:L1(接受)确认夜间条件下可看到的主题和场景内容;L2(技术评估)确定主要扭曲情况和严重程度;L3(本地化)探测空间范围和受影响区域;L4(重新确定)探测因果和比较判断,需要结合多个提示。 大多数问题都是1+2+1设计后的四可选择的单答项目:一个正确答案,两个从同一场景可以令人信服的属性中抽取的硬分光器(例如相邻的重度级,共同发生的扭曲类型,或另一个受影响的区域),以及一个与图像明显不一致的容易分光器. 2级的重度分级项目取而代之的是使用三个固定选项 Slight /medrate / serious ,这样任何重度分级都可以成为正确的答案. 这种构成使任务具有歧视性,同时避免了微不足道的可猜测的项目.

blocks.en: The chain-of-thought rationale attached to each question is generated under a blind-test constraint: the rationale must describe the visual evidence and reasoning that lead to the answer without stating the option letter or copying the answer text, and a fixed list of forbidden answer-revealing phrases is enforced during structural screening (Section C.1 , step 2). This prevents the rationale from leaking the answer and forces the model to articulate grounded perceptual evidence, which is what the description reward r desc r_{\text{desc}} (Section F.3 ) later supervises.
blocks.zh: 每一个问题所附带的思维链原理都是在盲目测试制约下产生的:原理必须描述导致答案的视觉证据和推理,而无需说明选项字母或复制答案文本;在结构筛选期间,强制实施一个禁止解答-启示短语的固定清单(C.1节,步骤2)。 这防止了理由泄露答案,迫使模型阐明有根据的感知证据,这是描述奖励r desc r_{\text{desc}}(F.3节)后来监督的内容.

blocks.en: Each distortion is synthesized at two severity levels ( Medium and Severe ). Medium parameters are stochastically sampled; Severe parameters are derived by applying a fixed scaling factor.

blocks.en: NightIQA-Real and NightIQA-Syn use different severity granularities by design. Real captures carry the three perceptual levels used by human annotators ( Slight / Moderate / Severe , Section A.1 ), because real degradations form a continuum that annotators can resolve into three bands. Synthetic degradations are generated at two controllable levels ( Medium / Severe ), since the parameters are programmatically set and the goal is to expose the model to a clearly moderate and a clearly strong instance of each type. When the two sources are combined for training, the synthetic Medium level is aligned with the real Slight – Moderate range and Severe with Severe , so that severity supervision remains consistent across the real and synthetic portions of the data.
blocks.zh: NightIQA-Real和NightIQA-Syn通过设计使用不同的重度颗粒. 真实的捕捉会携带人类注释者使用的三种感官水平(Slight /medrate / Special., 第A.1节),因为真实的降解会形成一个连续体,注释者可以分解成三个波段. 合成降解是在两个可控制层次(中/严重)产生的,因为参数是按方案设定的,目标是使模型暴露在每种类型的明显中度和明显强烈的案例中。 当两个来源合并起来进行培训时,合成中位数与真正的Slight(中度范围)和Specific(严重)一致,这样,在数据的真实和合成部分中,对严重程度的监督就保持一致。

blocks.en: D.4 Synthetic Distortion Validation
blocks.zh: D.4 合成扭曲验证

blocks.en: Before SFT sampling (Supp. Sec. D.5 ), every generated image passes an automated quality-control step that verifies the intended distortion was actually rendered and is consistent with its structured label. An MLLM inspector receives the degraded image together with the expected distortion type, severity, scope, and the structured chain-of-thought description, and is queried with the prompt of Figure 18 . The judge returns a JSON verdict covering distortion presence, type match, scope accuracy, target reasonableness (for instance-level distortions), and severity consistency, plus an objective perceived-severity rating assessed independently of the label and a 1 1 – 10 10 quality score. An image is retained only when all boolean checks pass, the quality score is ≥ 7 \geq 7 , and no critical issue is flagged; otherwise it is discarded. The check is scope-aware: global distortions must affect the entire frame uniformly, whereas instance-level distortions must be confined to a semantically appropriate target (light sources for Local Overexposure, moving objects for Motion Blur, depth-separated objects for Focus Blur), so that a mismatched target (e.g., motion blur on a static building) is marked as a failure.

blocks.en: During GRPO training, the following system prompt is prepended:
blocks.zh: 在GRPO培训期间,准备采用以下系统提示:

blocks.en: You are a nighttime image quality assessment expert. Begin your response with a <thinking> tag. Inside, provide a fluent, non-repetitive prose analysis of the nighttime image’s visual characteristics, including brightness distribution, noise level, detail preservation, color fidelity, and any visible distortions. Do NOT use option prefixes such as “A.”, “B.” inside the thinking section to avoid leaking your answer tendency. After the analysis, output the final option letter inside an <answer> tag.
blocks.zh: 你是夜间图像质量评估专家 以“ 思考” 标签开始响应 。 内部提供流利的,非重复的道词分析夜景图像的视觉特征,包括亮度分布,噪声水平,细节保存,色彩忠实,以及任何明显的扭曲. 在思维部分不要使用“A.”、“B.”等选项前缀来避免漏出答案的趋势。 分析后,将最后选项字母输出在 < answer > 标记中。

blocks.en: All NightIQA-Real images were captured by the research team; no images were sourced from surveillance systems, social media, or unconsented third parties.
